_comment: Paths may use ${VAR}, expanded from the environment when the config is
loaded. A referenced variable that is not set is an error naming the variable.
The manifest records the resolved path and its sha256.
PQPROBE_BIN  path to the pqprobe binary.
cdxgen is invoked through tools/cdxgen-docker.sh and the image pinned in
`image`. It is held at 12.8.2 in every run.

tools.name: cdxgen
tools.notes: Arguments mirror BF-CBOM's cdxgen worker. Records source files in properties[].SrcFile without line numbers. Invoked through the image in `image`, the 12.8.2 tag pinned by digest, so it needs no build root and runs the same on any host with Docker.

tools.name: pqprobe
tools.notes: Exit 1 means findings present, not failure. The binary path comes from PQPROBE_BIN; the manifest records what it resolved to and that file's sha256. Maintained by the maintainer of Proofstein (METHODOLOGY.md §9).
